option_relations.rationale: Congenital Hemangioblastoma does not match the histopathological findings and imaging studies described in the vignette.

Epithelioid Hemangioendothelioma matches the histopathological findings, including the vascular lesion with low levels of mitotic activity and the biphasic lesion composed of vascular nodules among spindle cells.
Kaposiform hemangioendothelioma (KHE) of the internal auditory canal is a specific type of Kaposiform Hemangioendothelioma, which matches the histopathological findings and the location of the mass.
Infantile hemangioma does not match the histopathological findings and imaging studies described in the vignette, which suggest a more aggressive vascular lesion.
